hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 swap curve between ETH and phiEth (an ETH 1:1 wrapper token). In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, then settles output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity additions are blocked; only ETH/phiEth zero-fee pools may use this hook.
